text: Meridianbet is a subsidiary of Golden Matrix Group Inc. (NASDAQ: GMGI), which acquired the Meridianbet Group in April 2024; on 3 March 2026 Golden Matrix Group rebranded as Meridian Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: MRDN).
